title: NVDA/AMD post-earnings drift setup into late-August tape
summary: NVIDIA beat and guided above consensus on AI accelerator demand; AMD guided cautiously but hyperscaler capex commentary supports the semi complex. Post-earnings drift typically extends 5-10 sessions for mega-cap semis.
hypothesis: AI-capacity buildout remains the dominant trade; semis with fresh beats keep their drift until the next macro shock.

title: Fed speakers this week: rate-path repricing risk
summary: Several FOMC members are scheduled to speak this week. Futures price ~3 cuts by mid-2027. Any hawkish pushback (inflation stickiness, tariff pass-through) would lift the 2Y yield and pressure rate-sensitive longs.
hypothesis: Rates remain the swing factor; day trades must respect the 9:30-10:30 window when Fed headlines land.

title: Oil: OPEC+ quota headlines vs demand fear
summary: WTI consolidating in the low-$70s. OPEC+ has flagged quota flexibility for September-October; China demand data is the swing factor. Energy has been range-bound — treat breakouts as low-confidence unless volume confirms.

title: Friday jobs report ahead: payrolls + NFP expectations
summary: Consensus expects ~+120k payrolls. A print above +160k lowers cut odds (bearish for growth); below +90k raises them (bullish for duration/growth). The 10Y sits at the middle of its 2-month range — a break beyond 4.4% or below 4.15% is the day-trade trigger.

title: Geopolitical risk premium moderate; gold bid steady
summary: Elevated geopolitical tensions (Middle East shipping, Red Sea rerouting) support gold and oil-supply risk. Gold holds its uptrend while real yields ease — dip-buying in GLD has worked for months; chase-risk is low unless headline escalates.

title: Insider activity monitor active
summary: No significant insider cluster detected in the last 48h for the universe (normal 10b5-1 noise only). Flagging this so the tracker learns: absence of insider selling is NOT a buy signal.

title: Options flow: watch for call-buying in AI names at open
summary: If NVDA/AMD see early call dominance with volume >1.5x average in the first 30 minutes, treat as confirmation of drift continuation; otherwise fade the gap. This is a discretionary intraday confirmation rule.

title: Retail sentiment: AAII bulls < 40%, still cautious
summary: AAII survey continues to show a cautious-to-neutral retail cohort. Contrarian lens: heavy caution is mildly supportive for equities near term, but sentiment is a slow signal — weak day-trade edge unless extreme (>55% bears).

title: AI/tech breakthroughs: enterprise AI capex cycle intact
summary: Cloud capex guidance across hyperscalers points to sustained AI infrastructure spend through 2027. Software and cloud names benefit from the same AI buildout narrative as semis. Watch for capex-cut headlines — they hit the whole complex.

title: Analyst moves: MSFT PT raised after Azure commentary
summary: At least one sell-side house raised its MSFT price target this week citing Azure momentum. PT raises near highs are low-edge for day trading (often priced in); treat as confluence, not a standalone trigger.

title: Historical analog: post-Labor-Day first week seasonality
summary: September historically has the weakest monthly average return of the year, but the first 2 sessions after Labor Day are often firm as vacation money returns. This week is a low-trust week for trend-following — favor mean-reversion and tight stops.
